title: Why Rabies Still Kills So Many, So Needlessly
hook: One bite. 100% fatal once it starts. Almost always preventable.
closing: Dogs cause it, and a cheap dog vaccine could stop it, saving thousands of lives.
question: Did you know rabies still kills this many?

segments.say: Once rabies symptoms start, it is 100 percent fatal, with no cure. But a shot before symptoms stops it every time.
Asia loses 35,000 people a year to rabies, and Africa most of the rest. Almost every death is in just those two places.
99 percent of human rabies cases start with a dog bite. So vaccinating dogs cuts off almost every case.
